invalid/not-json.json.why: The file isn't JSON: the last brace is missing.

invalid/not-utf8.json.why: The file isn't UTF-8: the name holds a Latin-1 byte.

invalid/byte-order-mark.json.why: The file starts with a byte order mark.

invalid/repeated-key.json.why: An object holds the same key twice, so its finish can't be told.

invalid/format-other.json.why: The format name is another name.

invalid/format-version-not-a-number.json.why: The format version is a string, not a whole number.

invalid/lots-missing.json.why: The list of lots is missing.

invalid/profile-name-blank.json.why: The profile's name is empty after trimming.

invalid/currency-lower-case.json.why: The currency isn't three upper-case letters.

invalid/entry-source-id-missing.json.why: A lot's entry has no source id.

invalid/entry-name-missing.json.why: A lot's entry lacks a descriptive field.

invalid/finish-left-out.json.why: A lot's finish is left out; not recorded is written as null.

invalid/condition-empty.json.why: A lot's condition is an empty string; not recorded is written as null.

invalid/price-one-place.json.why: A lot's price paid has one decimal place.

invalid/time-with-offset.json.why: A time is written with an offset, not with Z.

invalid/time-not-a-moment.json.why: A time has the right form but is no real moment: 30 February.

invalid/changed-before-added.json.why: A lot was last changed before it was added.

invalid/duplicate-lot.json.why: Two lots have the same lot identity; only their quantities differ.
